about_the_game:
Qullusrent3 — A True Puzzle Challenge Returns

Move every block to its designated position to clear the stage. The rules are simple, but the path to victory is anything but straightforward. Packed with intricate mechanics, each level demands deep thought and relentless trial and error. The moment you discover the breakthrough is pure exhilaration.

The demo version includes 12 stages, offering a hands-on introduction to the core mechanics and spatial logic that define the game. In the full version, you'll face 120 stages of layered complexity and diverse gimmicks that test your reasoning, spatial awareness, and creative problem-solving skills.

Built with DirectX11 and MFC/Win32, Qullusrent3 delivers lightweight yet high-precision rendering. Its camera-independent spatial design, powered by shaders, and its use of normal and depth-based visual control reflect a design philosophy rooted in physical plausibility and spatial coherence. The game requires an AVX2-compatible CPU and runs on Windows 10 x64 or later, maximizing both computational efficiency and visual fidelity.

Qullusrent3 also supports 51 languages, including Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Urdu, Burmese, Khmer, and more—allowing players around the world to experience the elegance of logic and space without language barriers.

Beneath its simple rules lies profound thinking. Qullusrent3 isn’t just about solving puzzles—it’s about enjoying the very act of thinking.
